Having withdrawn from the dazzling, intoxicating scene of revelry, I return to where the dream began, yet ethereal voices behind me mock myself, faint as a gossamer thread. Such a life is truly embarrassing and nauseating; those once fearful pupils in the box stare intently through the cracks. How I wish to escape, but death terrifies me.

samples.translation: kbtsh82 Osmanthus, belonging to the family Oleaceae, is an evergreen shrub or tree. Also known as "muxi," common varieties include red osmanthus, golden osmanthus, silver osmanthus, and four-season osmanthus. Leaves are opposite and leathery, with flower clusters growing in leaf axils. Flowering period is September to October, fruiting period is March to April of the following year. Osmanthus produces small, golden-yellow flowers with a strong fragrance. It is one of China's top ten famous flowers. Native to China, it is widely cultivated across the country. Flower clusters grow in leaf axils; flowers are pale yellow-white with four lobes. The drupe is elliptical, turning purplish-black when ripe. The flowers are aromatic and used for fragrance extraction.

samples.original: 看的脑壳疼，黑话太多了。尼采批判了早年崇拜对象叔本华和瓦格纳，并将他们当做对跖者，从生理学上对瓦格纳的音乐进行批判。他认为瓦格纳的音乐是藏在理想光环中的虚无主义，是灾难性的蛊惑人心的。拿代表作帕西法尔说，是一部充满险恶复仇的作品，是病态的基督教道德的表现。尼采认为瓦格纳是一个“演员”，其实书中并没有对他作曲层面的批评，尼采还是承认瓦格纳在那个时代是最牛皮作曲家，最多就是提到了“旋律非道德”。瓦格纳在歌剧上的创新，取消宣叙调，咏叹调，合唱等固定套式的段落，用“无终旋律”来取代，还有介乎说与唱之间的“念唱旋律”。但尼采认为瓦格纳中的音乐元素都是不真实的，而是虚无的表演性质。感觉更多的是两个人观念和宗教信仰的分歧。想的太多真的会发疯，所以尼采疯了。
samples.translation: Reading this gives me a headache, too much jargon. Nietzsche criticized his early idols Schopenhauer and Wagner, treating them as antipodes, and critiqued Wagner's music from a physiological perspective. He believed Wagner's music was nihilism hidden in an ideal halo, a disastrous seduction. Taking the representative work Parsifal as an example, it's a work full of sinister revenge, an expression of pathological Christian morality. Nietzsche considered Wagner an "actor"; actually, the book doesn't criticize his composition level—Nietzsche still acknowledged Wagner as the most awesome composer of that era, at most mentioning "melodic immorality." Wagner's innovations in opera, abolishing fixed patterns like recitative, aria, and chorus, replacing them with "endless melody," and the "Sprechgesang" between speaking and singing. But Nietzsche believed the musical elements in Wagner were inauthentic, but rather nihilistic performance. It feels more like a divergence in their ideas and religious beliefs. Thinking too much really can drive one insane, so Nietzsche went mad.

samples.original: 第一次一个人去看病，是在高一的时候。我是藉由着跟家里人说，“我和同学去逛街”偷跑去医院的。第一次自己去医院，手忙脚乱的，挂号、找科室、付费等等都花了老半天。我原以为这一天就可以把我的病看好了，结果医生给我开了张单子，告诉我：“下周一上午来做心脏彩超。”那一瞬间，我慌了。周一是要上课的，我不可能翘课自己偷跑来；既然不是偷偷出来，势必是要告诉父母了。我害怕的是，我父母要知道了，要知道，我一个人来看病。他们会心疼，为什么我不告诉他们，自己一个人偷跑出来。而这，恰恰是我一个人出来的原因。我不想让他们为我担心。毕竟还是个高一的学生，没经历过这样的事情。中午，我出医院后，大脑空空的，也不知道往哪儿走。因为和母亲说了，是和同学出来玩，势必不可能这时候回家的，作息就要做全套。我慌乱地打电话给我最好的朋友，支支吾吾地跟她说，“我今天去医院了，我好像，生病了…”这时候我才恍然意识到，我害怕的，不仅是事情败露，还有对疾病的未知的恐惧。这对于16岁的孩子还是挺难接受的。我一辈子都感谢我那个最好的朋友，她陪伴了我那最忐忑不安的一个下午，尽管我们已经分道扬镳。最后，晚上，我还是和父母坦白了。我哭得稀里哗啦的，父母都以为我是害怕生病，只有我自己知道，我是在内疚，“对不起，让你们担心了。”周一，去医院检查，查出患有先心病。预约专家门诊，复诊，寒假安排了手术，再复诊。我的亲戚们都知道我一个人看病的事，都感叹我是个好懂事的小孩。这是我最不喜欢听到和发生的情况。我为什么不想告诉我父母呢？因为我母亲查出脑瘤，只有两年半的时间了，知道这消息时的我是初三。我真的真的，不想再让她操心了。真的，两年半，不早不晚，她很准时地离开了我。这三年里，我每一个辗转反侧的夜里，都能想起她离开的那个夜晚。而我也将永远忏悔。“对不起，没有好好陪你。”“对不起，让你担心了。”
samples.translation: The first time I went to see a doctor alone was in my first year of high school. I sneaked off to the hospital by telling my family, "I'm going shopping with classmates." It was my first time going to the hospital by myself, and I was all flustered—registering, finding the department, paying, and so on took me ages. I thought I could get my illness treated that same day, but the doctor gave me a slip and said, "Come next Monday morning for an echocardiogram." In that moment, I panicked. Monday was a school day; I couldn't skip class and sneak out again. Since I couldn't go secretly, I would inevitably have to tell my parents. What I feared was that my parents would find out—they would find out that I had gone to see a doctor alone. They would feel heartbroken, wondering why I didn't tell them and instead sneaked out by myself. And that was precisely why I went alone. I didn't want them to worry about me. After all, I was still a first-year high school student and had never experienced anything like this. At noon, after leaving the hospital, my mind went blank, and I didn't know where to go. Since I had told my mom I was out with friends, I couldn't go home at that time—I had to keep up the act. Frantically, I called my best friend and stammered, "I went to the hospital today... I think I'm sick..." It was only then that I suddenly realized what I was afraid of wasn't just being found out, but also the fear of the unknown illness. For a 16-year-old, that was quite hard to accept. I will always be grateful to that best friend of mine, who stayed with me through that most anxious afternoon, even though we have since gone our separate ways. In the end, that evening, I confessed to my parents. I cried uncontrollably. My parents thought I was scared of being sick, but only I knew it was guilt: "I'm sorry for making you worry." On Monday, I went to the hospital for the examination and was diagnosed with congenital heart disease. I scheduled an appointment with a specialist, followed up, had surgery arranged during winter break, and followed up again. My relatives all found out that I had gone to the doctor alone and praised me for being such a sensible child. That was the situation I least wanted to hear about or experience

samples.original: 很意外地看见了宋洋。看见他的戏，他的脸，忽然就好生亲切。如旧友重逢，心底的温热一直漫到眼底。后来周遭有一片忧思。感伤这世间一个个有血有肉的人，感喟我对自己的事业追求并不曾有过这样的珍稀的信念。人之价值何去？人之伟大何归？我仍旧迷茫。一点点试着感受人的坚持所带来之张力之迷人。我过去总更情愿自己待在壳里静静鼓捣自己的术业，不闻窗外事。但在那个寂寂的夜声里我忽然变了想法，我竟愿意去踏足我过去不擅长总是回避当没这回事的所在了。其他的，或许根本轮不上我来不平或者难过，故自己以外的人或事，不敢多妄言了。克制着心绪，权作对这世间仍默默耕耘人之敬意吧。
samples.translation: Unexpectedly saw Song Yang. Seeing his performance, his face, suddenly felt so familiar. Like reuniting with an old friend, the warmth in my heart spread all the way to my eyes. Later, there was a wave of melancholy around me. Grieving for each flesh-and-blood person in this world, lamenting that I have never held such precious conviction in my own career pursuits. Where does human value go? Where does human greatness return? I am still lost. Little by little, trying to feel the captivating tension brought by human perseverance. I used to prefer staying in my shell, quietly tinkering with my own craft, oblivious to the outside world. But in that silent night, I suddenly changed my mind—I am now willing to step into places I used to avoid, act as if they didn’t exist, because I wasn’t good at them. As for the rest, perhaps it’s not my place to feel indignant or sad; regarding people or matters beyond myself, I dare not speak recklessly. Restraining my emotions, I’ll take it as a tribute to those who still toil silently in this world.

samples.translation: 📚 I'm waiting for the wind and also waiting for you. 21 emotional stories about waiting, meeting, companionship, breakups, longing, sharing with you determined and courageous pursuits of love, unrequited loves that yield no results despite much thought, the joys and sorrows that twist and turn... These stories are like short microfilms about love. Each one stirs the emotions within, some will inexplicably bring tears to your eyes, some will make you smile knowingly, some will make your cheeks flush without you realizing, and some inevitably make you sigh with regret... Although I haven't experienced love, it seems like I can find my own shadow in some stories, occasionally empathizing. I've made this book my bedside book, reading it every night before sleep, sometimes one story, sometimes several. What this book taught me is to be fearless when facing love, and firm when doubting love. "When you no longer possess something, what you must do is to not let yourself forget" – this is a line from the movie "Ashes of Time." If you get a chance, watch this movie. Also, don't become a prisoner of time, don't be a clown who only compromises. So much, so much, it basically taught me to be a girl who understands love in relationships. Hope I can use it in future love hahaha. If I ever become an irrational fool in love, I hope this book can still come in handy hahaha. So next, it's time to switch to another book 📋 This one, "Being a Just-Right Woman," is said to be a life makeup book dedicated to all women. It says in this book you can find good prescriptions to help enhance your charm index and dig out success capital. Hahahaha, hearing that is quite tempting. Looking forward to it, so let's start today #LastDayOfMay#

samples.original: 白斑病是一种病因复杂的皮肤病，很多原因都会导致白癜风疾病，这种疾病一旦患上会给人们的身心造成很大的困扰，那么秋季白癜风患者患病的原因是什么?　　外伤：外伤是白斑病的常见病因，外伤的出现会导致身体局部免疫异常、气血不和，免疫异常会对黑色素细胞造成损害，影响黑色素合成，从而诱发白斑病，白斑病是在气血失和的基础上引起的。除了外伤外，还会对皮肤造成其他刺激如抓挠、摩擦、接触有害化学物质等。　　阳光暴晒：阳光照晒可以促进黑色素合成，使人的皮肤变黑，但在阳光下长期暴晒会使皮肤上出现白斑，诱发白斑病。阳光暴晒会使黑色素细胞功能亢奋，过多的消耗黑色素细胞，使黑色素细胞过早衰亡，使黑色素无法正常合成，从而使人的皮肤上出现白斑。　　精神因素：精神因素也是白斑病的常见病因之一，很多人得白斑病的原因就是因为长期心理压力过大、精神压抑或受到严重刺激所致，各种不良情绪、心理起伏较大都会造成精神内分泌失调，影响免疫功能，从而对黑色素细胞造成损害，诱发白斑病出现。
samples.translation: Vitiligo is a skin disease with complex causes, and many factors can lead to the condition. Once contracted, it can cause significant physical and psychological distress. So, what are the causes of vitiligo in autumn? Trauma: Trauma is a common cause of vitiligo. The occurrence of trauma can lead to local immune abnormalities and imbalance of qi and blood in the body. Immune abnormalities can damage melanocytes, affecting melanin synthesis and thus triggering vitiligo, which is based on an imbalance of qi and blood. In addition to trauma, other skin irritations such as scratching, friction, and exposure to harmful chemicals can also contribute. Sun exposure: Sunlight can promote melanin synthesis, darkening the skin, but prolonged exposure to the sun can cause white patches on the skin and induce vitiligo. Sun exposure can overstimulate melanocytes, excessively depleting them and causing premature aging, which prevents normal melanin synthesis and leads to white patches on the skin. Psychological factors: Psychological factors are also a common cause of vitiligo. Many people develop vitiligo due to long-term excessive psychological stress, depression, or severe emotional shocks. Various negative emotions and significant psychological fluctuations can lead to endocrine imbalances, affect immune function, damage melanocytes, and trigger vitiligo.

samples.translation: I'm full and ready to start loving life, maybe for three or four hours though. I run and run but can't catch up with that version of myself that was once so full of promise. It's not that living is meaningless, it's that being poor is so meaningless. I hate that kind of listless, powerless feeling where being alive is no different from being dead. "Let it be" is the most powerless thing I've ever said to myself. The thing I regret most is wishing to grow up quickly when I was a child. Who says sad people must shed tears? Has anyone ever appreciated your kindness? Being too clear-headed is simply a mood-killer. The journey after the hustle and bustle, walking alone, is truly hard to endure. In every late night of self-collapse, I find that I actually haven't made any progress at all. Me, I simply don't dare to fall down. I really want to fast-forward life to the end, then see what I look like clinging to survival in old age. When I see friends around me getting better and better, I actually feel panicked and uneasy. I keep trying to adapt to the temperature of this world, whether it's the seasons or people's hearts.

samples.original: 所以，允许自己犯错，允许自己搞砸一些事，接受自己处于并将长期处于迷茫状态，接受自己暂时的穷且平凡，然后带着一颗强大的心脏，不怕失败地往前走吧。       别人的选择看似很好，但不一定适合你；别人的生活很好，但那也不是你焦虑迷茫的理由。每个人都有自己的生活方式，无所谓好坏，仅此而已。        迷茫是常态，却也是动态可变的。你只须接受自己的选择，并且坚持下去。只要你愿意努力做出改变，那些让你糟心的状态都会慢慢好起来。　　更重要的是，生活很少能完美，我们在享受自己选择所带来的好的同时，也必然要接受其中的不够好。        人最怕的不是困难挫折，而是在困难挫折面前顾影自怜。你要有一颗能抵御世事艰难的雄心，而不是过分柔软只会心疼自己。
samples.translation: So, allow yourself to make mistakes, allow yourself to mess some things up, accept that you are and will remain in a state of confusion for a long time, accept your temporary poverty and ordinariness, and then move forward with a strong heart, unafraid of failure. Others' choices may seem good, but they might not suit you; others' lives are good, but that's no reason for your anxiety and confusion. Everyone has their own way of life, with no inherent good or bad, that's all. Confusion is the norm, but it's also dynamic and changeable. You just need to accept your choices and persist. As long as you're willing to work hard to make changes, those distressing states will gradually improve. More importantly, life is rarely perfect; while we enjoy the good that our choices bring, we must also accept the not-so-good aspects. What people fear most is not difficulties or setbacks, but self-pity in the face of them. You need a heart ambitious enough to withstand life's hardships, not one that is overly soft and only feels sorry for itself.

samples.original: 四肢上长了白癜风怎么治疗恢复得快?　　想要疾病好得快，那么首先患者对于疾病就需要有更多的认识。白癜风治疗难度很大，长在四肢处白斑更加不好治。肢端型白癜风是白癜风类型中患病率较高，且治疗难度比较复杂的一种。那么，四肢上长了白癜风怎么治疗恢复得快?　　肢端型白癜风治疗不可盲目　　很多患者由于心系病情，很容易被别人钻空子，盲目听信所谓的偏方、特效药。可能在刚开始时，患者可以看到一些效果，但是时间久了，患者就会看到白斑扩散越加严重。因此，建议患者不要盲目使用偏方、药物进行治疗。肢端型白癜风本身治疗难度就比较大，想要治好它，只有靠科学医治才能够解决这一困扰。而不是盲目治疗、胡乱用药，那样只会适得其反。　　面对疾病及时调整好心态康复得更快　　被疾病缠上，相信大家都不会有好心情，但是如果患者们不能及时调整好自己心态的话，那么也会直接影响到病情。据临床表明，因为肢端型白癜风严重影响个人形象，很多病人在治疗时都会十分担忧自身疾病能否得到比较好的治疗，是否可以快速的治好。所以，很多患者也会产生不同程度心理问题。精神状况对于白癜风治疗影响非常大。思想压力大了，对自己身体造成了影响不说，患者还会出现情绪低落到不愿意配合治疗的情况，白癜风的治疗效果会大大降低。　　温馨提示：面对顽疾，靠患者自己或者光靠医生都不能完美地解决这一困扰，想要疾病好得快，除了要有个好医院、好技术以外，患者自身配合度也十分重要。因此，患者一定要积极配合医生治疗，坚持白癜风护理，争取早日恢复健康。
samples.translation: How to treat and recover quickly from vitiligo on the limbs? To recover quickly from the disease, patients first need to have a better understanding of it. Vitiligo is difficult to treat, and white patches on the limbs are even harder to cure. Acral vitiligo is a type with a high prevalence and complex treatment difficulty. So, how can vitiligo on the limbs be treated for a fast recovery? Do not treat acral vitiligo blindly. Many patients, due to their concern about the condition, are easily taken advantage of and blindly believe in so-called folk remedies or miracle drugs. Initially, patients may see some effects, but over time, they will notice the white patches spreading more severely. Therefore, it is recommended that patients avoid blindly using folk remedies or medications for treatment. Acral vitiligo itself is challenging to treat; to cure it, only scientific medical treatment can resolve this issue. Blind treatment or胡乱用药 (haphazard medication) will only backfire. Adjusting mindset promptly leads to faster recovery. Being afflicted by a disease, it's understandable that no one feels good, but if patients cannot adjust their mindset in time, it will directly affect the condition. Clinical observations show that because acral vitiligo severely impacts personal appearance, many patients worry greatly during treatment about whether their disease can be effectively treated and cured quickly. Consequently, many patients also develop varying degrees of psychological issues. Mental state significantly influences vitiligo treatment. Excessive psychological pressure not only affects one's body but can also lead to low mood and unwillingness to cooperate with treatment, greatly reducing the effectiveness of vitiligo treatment. Reminder: Facing a stubborn disease, relying solely on the patient or the doctor cannot perfectly resolve this issue. To recover quickly, besides having a good hospital and technology, the patient's own cooperation is also crucial. Therefore, patients must actively cooperate with doctors, persist in vitiligo care, and strive for an early recovery to health.

samples.translation: My phone is really quite important to me. Only with my phone can I surf the internet anytime, share my life with my very, very good friends who live far away, and chatter endlessly about every little detail of my life. samples.original: 提问：玩动森玩到眼睛干涩酸胀是什么体验？ 动森这个游戏真的是，太不适合佛系玩家了，我上岛到现在几乎天天肝。一直盯着屏幕观察岛上动态，真的很费眼睛，睡前还要瞄一眼游戏里的余额，醒来又忙着计划一波岛的设计，全岛小动物的幸福生活都靠我思前顾后。不是说好的养老游戏吗？ 还有比如说游戏里每周都有大头菜的期货买卖，周日买入、后六天卖出，是最容易翻身成富翁的赚钱项目😂大家基本都是找最低价买入、最高价卖出，如果买的多的话，还要连续不停的联机出入别人家、外出过程中超害怕掉线回档（盯住）。我有天尝试炒了一波期货，几个小时都在飞来飞去，赚了一千万，但眼睛就没停过！ 我相信很多人都有类似的经历，周一开始就在盯着微博微信等平台想要找合适的价格，然后再盯着排队，盯着起飞。 眼睛都不带一下眨的，感觉眼角膜的水分都蒸发了我都还能继续睁着眼睛搜索“情报”🔎（危险行为，请勿模仿⚠️） 果然，报应来了，眼睛又酸又痛。 我最近的眼药水滴的频率越来越高了，但是又很担心眼药水里面的防腐剂和一些成分会加重内脏负担，而且滴久了感觉眼睛反而越来越容易干了...... 很巧的是，萌ya家的小姐姐来问我要不要试一下他们家的护眼仪，热敷和按摩功能都是眼科医生推荐的护理方法，我就......很愉快地答应了。 也不知道到底有没有用，这种产品不会是智商税吧？ 用了以后你就不会这么说了。 你知道成年以后近视度数还会加深吗？你知道过度用眼最严重的时候可以致盲吗？你想知道玩动森赚金币比别人快的秘籍吗？ 请你一定要认真仔细看完下面的图文，超大浮力在此！
samples.translation: Question: What's it like to play Animal Crossing until your eyes feel dry, sore, and strained? Animal Crossing is really not suitable for casual players at all. Since I started on my island, I've been grinding almost every day. Constantly staring at the screen to monitor the island's happenings is really hard on the eyes. Before bed, I still peek at my in-game balance, and upon waking, I'm busy planning the next wave of island design. The happy lives of all the island animals depend on my careful consideration. Wasn't this supposed to be a relaxing retirement game? Also, for example, there's the weekly turnip futures trading in the game—buy on Sunday, sell in the next six days—it's the easiest project to turn into a fortune 😂. Everyone basically looks for the lowest price to buy and the highest to sell. If you buy a lot, you have to continuously travel online to other people's islands, and during the trips, you're super afraid of disconnecting and losing progress (staring intently). One day I tried speculating in turnips, spent hours flying back and forth, made 10 million bells, but my eyes never got a break! I believe many people have similar experiences. Starting Monday, they stare at platforms like Weibo and WeChat looking for suitable prices, then stare while waiting in line, stare during takeoff. Not even blinking, feeling like the moisture in my corneas has evaporated, yet I can still keep my eyes open searching for "intel" 🔎 (dangerous behavior, do not imitate ⚠️). Sure enough, retribution came—my eyes are sore and painful. Lately, I've been using eye drops more and more frequently, but I'm also worried that the preservatives and some ingredients in the drops might increase the burden on my internal organs, and after long-term use, my eyes actually feel like they're getting drier... Coincidentally, a representative from Mengya contacted me asking if I wanted to try their eye care device, with heat therapy and massage functions recommended by ophthalmologists as care methods, so I... happily agreed. Not sure if it's actually useful or if this kind of product is just an IQ tax? You won't say that after using it. Did you know that nearsightedness can still worsen after adulthood? Do you know that excessive eye strain at its most severe can lead to blindness? Do you want to know the secret to earning Animal Crossing bells

samples.translation: Dead loop—Thoughts during an afternoon bike ride: walkers envy the drive of cyclists, cyclists envy the comfort of car riders, car riders envy the leisure of walkers. In fact, everyone has something they envy, because no one is ever content with their current situation (and always envies what others have). Life is like climbing a slope; though you may grow weary near the top and even want to give up, if you persevere, you will surely conquer that high ground. Of course, once you reach the peak, the downhill path inevitably follows. If you can’t hold back, you’ll experience the taste of sliding from the summit to the valley. The downhill can also be seen as a reward for the hardship of the ascent. We can’t know how deep the next valley will be, because after all, we’re all walking this path of life for the first time. When life hits rock bottom, please believe that the next step is surely the start of an uphill climb. Even if the journey is exhausting, trust your choices—even if they lead in the wrong direction, we can brush off the dust beneath us and say with a smile that life itself is a process of finding our own way. samples.translation: If I were to film Dou Wei, I wouldn't start the documentary with musical instruments. I would film a table. An indescribable yellow covers the four-legged solid wood table. The paint on its surface doesn't need to be peeling. The table is draped with a white cloth, the cloth is starch-white. On the cloth is a book, its cover entirely white, with his name in traditional Chinese characters in bold black, followed by pinyin. The book's content is completely blank, its stark white pages flipping continuously in the wind, the white cloth also swaying gently, only the table remains motionless, silent. The table appears on a sidewalk, some people stop to look, some hurry by, some glance and sneer, some ignore it completely. It remains silent. It appears on the loess ground, beside it a vigorous and eerie dead tree points straight at the sky, the sky is blue. Sparrows peck at the book with their beaks, their feathers all indifferent. It remains silent. It appears again in an abandoned factory, the steel bars are taut, motionless. It remains silent. A hearse pulling wreaths speeds past, paper flowers on its roof plummet down in the strong wind, a woman reaches out and catches one, telling me it's fragrant. On the streets, people's tightly shut doors resemble unburied coffins. The table remains silent. The swirling, fierce wind stops. @译乐队

samples.original: 印广法师印广法师大光明藏中谁非谁💐 《法华经》《楞严经》，说尽了宇宙万法来龙去脉－－人怎么来的？佛、菩萨、天、人、鬼、畜怎么来的？山河大地、风云雨雾怎么来的？人我是非、香甜苦辣、种种妄想分别这种意识怎么产生的？明白了万法的来龙去脉，我们再进一步地归纳总结这无量的万法相互之间是什么关系。十方三世到底有几尊佛、几尊菩萨、几个人、几个鬼、几个天、几滴雨、几片风……把这个道理搞明白，当下了生脱死，成分真即佛，永远不落六道轮回；往上不封顶，从住位菩萨到地位菩萨、十地菩萨、等觉菩萨，都可以当下一念就成就，乃至于个别的像龙女那样成为究竟圆满之佛。修圆顿大法，无量劫无量次第之功德可以成就于一生，成就于一时，成就于一念，就看听经闻法的思维观照如何、你的心态如何。而且，即使你是十恶不赦的罪犯，你只要一念明白「如来藏」的道理，如恒河沙数的罪恶一笔勾销；即使地狱境界现前，你可以当下变地狱为佛土，这叫「带业往生」。只要悟了，百分之百、千分之千，一个不漏、一个不卯，这是不可思议的大法呀！#搜孤救孤#法华楞严了义经典
samples.translation: Master Yinguang, Master Yinguang, in the great bright treasury, who is not who? 💐 The Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra exhaustively explain the origins and connections of all phenomena in the universe—how did humans come about? How did Buddhas, bodhisattvas, devas, humans, ghosts, and animals come about? How did mountains, rivers, the earth, wind, clouds, rain, and mist come about? How did consciousness, with its distinctions of self and other, right and wrong, sweet and bitter, and all sorts of delusional thoughts, arise? Once we understand the origins and connections of all phenomena, we further summarize what the relationships are among these countless phenomena. Exactly how many Buddhas, bodhisattvas, humans, ghosts, devas, drops of rain, gusts of wind... exist across the ten directions and three times? Understanding this principle leads to immediate liberation from birth and death, becoming a truly awakened Buddha, forever free from the six realms of rebirth; with no upper limit, from abiding-stage bodhisattvas to ground-stage bodhisattvas, ten-ground bodhisattvas, and equal-enlightenment bodhisattvas, all can achieve realization in a single thought, and even exceptional ones like the Dragon Girl can become completely perfect Buddhas. Cultivating the perfect and sudden great dharma, the merits accumulated over countless eons and stages can be accomplished in one lifetime, in one moment, in one thought—it depends on how one contemplates and reflects while listening to the teachings, and on one's mental attitude. Moreover, even if you are a heinous criminal, simply understanding the principle of the "Tathagata-garbha" in one thought erases sins as numerous as the sands of the Ganges; even if hellish realms appear before you, you can instantly transform hell into a Buddha-land—this is called "rebirth with karmic baggage." Once awakened, one hundred percent, one thousand percent, not a single one is missed or lacking—this is the inconceivable great dharma! #Searching and Saving the Orphan #The Lotus and Shurangama Definitive Sutras

samples.original: 就很害怕，刺探军情让留电话号码，我想了想没有留我自己的，或许是脑子抽抽了，留得之前我爸的号，就算我已经再也不会给这个号码打电话，但是因为qq登录密码一直是他手机号，所以从来也没忘记。但是我大意了，人死之后，手机号一直交着费用也是可以用的吧，毕竟营业厅只看余额。或许号码在哪个亲戚手里吧，我前脚留电话，后脚看见我留的电话给我打电话，惊悚程度可见一斑，电话恐惧症当场发作我必须得承认我的自私和薄情，无论那些和我还有着些微血缘关系的人是要关心还是要询问什么，我始终认可的血亲就是只此一个且已不在人世。而剩下的人留给我的只有梦魇，我也不明白一件屁大点事怎么会成为我的梦魇，但是就是这样。我做重复的梦，很多次，我不想回去，开始挣扎，之后一味得逃，后来就在梦里自我毁灭。这种百分百不问缘由的逃离，或许在我真的决定去死的那一刻也不会变。
samples.translation: I'm just really scared. They were probing for military information and asked for a phone number. I thought about it and didn't give my own. Maybe my brain short-circuited, but I gave my dad's old number instead. Even though I'll never call that number again, I've never forgotten it because it was always his number for QQ login passwords. But I was careless. After someone dies, if you keep paying the fees, the phone number can still be used, right? After all, the service provider only checks the balance. Maybe the number is in some relative's hands. Right after I left the number, I saw a call coming in from that very number. The horror of that moment is hard to describe—my phone phobia instantly flared up. I have to admit my selfishness and coldness. No matter if those people who still share a faint blood tie with me want to show concern or ask something, the only blood relative I truly acknowledge is that one person, and they're no longer in this world. The others have left me with nothing but nightmares. I don't understand how such a trivial matter could become my nightmare, but it just did. I have the same dream repeatedly, many times. I don't want to go back, I start struggling, then I just run away, and later in the dream, I self-destruct. This instinct to flee without asking any questions probably won't change even at the moment I truly decide to die.
samples.label: depression

samples.original: #菜椒椒日记# 我的想法真的是一瞬间的，前一阵还在想我不能没有他，他是我的好朋友，甚至可以作为我以后如果即将孤独终老的救命稻草。打了个电话，加上一次日常聊天，一瞬间全打消了，不合适，就是不合适了。甚至有点讨厌。我可能就是想要有人陪吧，这个人可以是同性异性，但是要是我愿意的亲密关系，是我愿意付出的关系。可能我真的是依赖别人的那种吧。我希望有一个人是属于我的，是我们自己互相从属的。是我来到这世上不后悔的。修牙的我也有点想往后退一步了，我可不再想找一个满身负能量的人了，太糟心。我也承受不住。够苦的了我自己一个人，任何人都别想再给我施加压力。见面试试看吧。我还有一场演唱会要看呢，那是我曾经在快乐时期的寄托。如果北京进展顺利，如果25号大麦还有票可以买，天津那场我也想去看一看。
samples.translation: #CaiJiaoJiao Diary# My thoughts really change in an instant. Just a while ago I was thinking I couldn't live without him, he's my good friend, even a lifeline if I were to end up alone in the future. But after one phone call and a regular chat, all those thoughts vanished instantly. It's just not suitable, really not suitable. I even feel a bit of dislike. Maybe I just want someone to accompany me, this person could be of the same or opposite sex, but it has to be an intimate relationship I'm willing to be in, one I'm willing to invest in. Maybe I really am the type who depends on others. I hope there's someone who belongs to me, someone we mutually belong to. Someone who makes me feel I didn't come into this world for nothing. I also want to take a step back from the person fixing my teeth, I don't want to find someone full of negative energy anymore, it's too draining. I can't handle it. My own life is hard enough alone, no one should try to add more pressure on me. Let's meet and see. I still have a concert to attend, it was my solace during happier times. samples.original: 聊聊【泡茶】这件事泡茶是茶叶加工工艺的最后一道工序，茶汤入口之前人对茶所做的所有干预，都应算作工艺，泡茶过程会影响茶汤的呈现方式，泡茶可以彰显工艺的优势，也可以调整弥补工艺的一些不足。我们所说的相对完美的茶汤，五味结构，是少酸少苦，多鲜多甘，有辛必然要体现出辛。泡茶手法上思考如何调整各种滋味的呈现。比如酸，高温、久闷、酸重，如果要降低茶汤中的酸则可以降低水温，减少浸泡时间，降低冲击力度。酸味一般在前几泡偏重，这个重酸期过渡之后就可以恢复正常的冲泡手法，逐渐提高水温，延长浸泡时间。比如苦，抱茶量大，慢注水，低注水，久闷，苦重。如果要降低茶汤苦，则可以减少投茶量，相对拉高注水力度，减少浸泡时间，苦重期也在前段，头几泡容易重苦的阶段渡过之后，恢复正常泡法。比如鲜，低温，轻注水，可更大程度保有茶的鲜味，如若是咸，刚前段时间不能久闷，应高温快出汤。比如甘，顺畅注水均匀释放，茶汤饱甘甜。比如辛，务必高温有力度注水激发。可能还有一些需要推敲之处，可能还有用了什么茶器也是有影响的，但思考的角度值得探讨，与同好分享#茶##日常# 厦门·天成花园
samples.translation: Talking about 【brewing tea】 Brewing tea is the final step in tea processing. All interventions made to the tea before the tea soup enters the mouth should be considered part of the craft. The brewing process affects how the tea soup is presented; it can highlight the advantages of the craft and also adjust or compensate for some shortcomings. The relatively perfect tea soup we refer to has a five-flavor structure: less sourness and bitterness, more freshness and sweetness, and if there is pungency, it must be distinctly expressed. In brewing technique, consider how to adjust the presentation of various flavors. For example, sourness: high temperature, long steeping, strong sourness. To reduce sourness in the tea soup, you can lower the water temperature, shorten the steeping time, and reduce the intensity of pouring. Sourness is usually heavier in the first few brews; after this heavy sourness period passes, you can resume normal brewing methods, gradually increasing water temperature and extending steeping time. For example, bitterness: large amount of tea leaves, slow pouring, low pouring, long steeping, strong bitterness. To reduce bitterness in the tea soup, you can reduce the amount of tea leaves, relatively increase the pouring intensity, and shorten the steeping time. The heavy bitterness period is also in the early stage; after getting through the first few brews that tend to be heavily bitter, return to normal brewing. For example, freshness: low temperature, gentle pouring can better preserve the tea's freshness. If it's salty, do not steep for long initially; use high temperature and quick infusion. For example, sweetness: smooth, even pouring releases sweetness fully, making the tea soup rich and sweet. For example, pungency: be sure to use high temperature and forceful pouring to stimulate it. There may still be some points to refine, and the choice of tea ware may also have an impact, but the angle of thinking is worth discussing, sharing with fellow enthusiasts #tea #daily life# Xiamen · Tiancheng Garden

Don't refuse sadness; just go ahead and be sad, be angry. If you can't hold back tears, then cry your heart out. In my dreams, there has always been an impassable river; it feels like I've been there, yet also like I've never been. A cactus is covered in thorns and cannot become a flower. When victims become perpetrators, when onlookers become enablers, in this farce called a "joke," there are no bystanders, only perpetrators. When the wind and snow pass, leaving me a frosty bloom, let me remember the world is cold, but you are warm as a river. samples.translation: Haven't written a casual journal in a while, let's jot down some recent updates~ Historically heaviest at 106 jin. Lost weight for art exams over a week-plus down to 96 jin. Then, three months prepping for the college entrance exam, eating takeout, snacks, late-night meals daily, plus three months of home-cooked and restaurant summer feasts—six months total—rose to 103 jin. Nearing the start of school, thought to lose some, dropped to 99 jin in a few days. Started school in Xiamen and went on eating sprees, but somehow maybe not eating extremely excessively? Still ate a ton, weirdly, plus walking to class and such (military training basically didn't count since I took sick leave, no training haha lazy method~). Result: by winter break heading back to Shenzhen, weight fell to 98 jin. Home for winter break, ate a lot but couldn't constantly order takeout or binge-eat due to the pandemic (normally at home, besides meals, I'd order multiple takeouts like milk tea, snacks daily—because only binge-eating makes me gain or maintain weight; if eating normally, I keep losing). Stuck at home, couldn't consume high-calorie milk tea, burgers, chicken wings frantically. Though made cakes, barbecues, and feasts at home, it was far from enough. So, post-pandemic, I slimmed to 92 jin, then traveled for two months, still eating lots but maybe due to walking, weight stayed unchanged. Finally, by September, quitting sugar, oil, fried foods for skin care, about two weeks, mostly eating dumplings and other low-sugar foods. Calories were normal, not worried about high-cal, but almost all high-cal foods are sugary/oily, so frustrating. Result: slimmed to 89 jin. After two weeks, weight unchanged, went to Xiamen, quit sugar again for a few days (less strict this time, didn't quit oil/fried), but dropped to 87 jin. Birthday plus holidays, ate feasts, milk tea, junk for over a week, now back to 89 jin. Though I look just fine, not scarily thin, 89 jin still sounds a bit terrifying. Hope zql's recent resumed binge-eating can slowly gain back to over 90 jin!!~ (But what I call binge-eating is just normal eating whatever I want for my appetite). Super easy-to

samples.translation: [ZAF's Lifestyle] What makes professors step down from their pedestals and instantly turn adorably silly? Z's mom's doctoral supervisor, let's call her Grandma S, has been organizing a series of academic seminars titled "Ethics and Mythology in Artistic Creation" since 2012. One session per month counts as class hours, so Z's mom never skips. This month, due to France's second lockdown, in-person sessions aren't possible. Grandma S emailed students for help on using cloud video conferencing. After much hassle, the date was changed from Double Eleven to a weekend, and the time was shifted from afternoon to early morning. Holding a child while eating breakfast and watching a reality show for entertainment: one moment a professor calls Grandma S asking how to join the cloud meeting room; another speaker who's already connected starts talking but we can't hear what he's saying, only his wife using a vacuum cleaner; a usually stern professor appears on camera wearing an apron; and two professors accidentally send a private message to everyone due to shaky hands... Recalling two days ago when @拙石小憨 @克莱尔酱酱酱 attended their friend's online doctoral defense, they were happily toasting with champagne when they were called out for forgetting to turn off their camera, with the doctoral candidate, supervisor, and defense committee all watching. Perhaps the distance between all aloof scholars and experts and being cute is just one cloud meeting room away! #zafinparis #healingandawesome #confusingbehaviorawards #kindoffunny #healingandawesome

samples.original: 。　　总觉得我开始变成了一个尖酸刻薄又讨人厌的人。　　在很久之前，我记得我还是个很有耐心也算得上温柔的人，有人说过我倔，却从来没人说过我脾气不好，就连跟别人闹矛盾我也是温温和和的，几乎不讲一句重话。可是最近，具体就在这一次回家后，我突然就发现自己变得尖酸刻薄又易怒，连之前陪妹妹玩的耐心也几乎半点都不剩。　　我每次生气之后一直会想，到底是她们太过分了还是我反应过激了呢？　　比如那天我们部门的某个小干事因为某些原因少做了一期节目，其他人都几乎没什么反应就只有我内心实在是气愤，极其不友好的凶了他一顿，但其实我在和他聊天的时候已经在很努力的压着脾气，毕竟隔着屏幕我可以把自己的形象维持的温和一点。但是他还是悄悄的提过一声，xx学姐好凶啊。　　在面对别人的时候也许好很多，但是越跟我熟悉的人我就会越不客气，颇有些恃宠而骄的意味。　　但是，是很讨厌的那种恃宠而骄。　　前两天我和一个关系很好的男孩子聊天，他在学校表白墙上看见一张照片发给我，也许是单纯开玩笑的说你要不要试试这个小姑娘说的这个发型，或许是我那会儿本来情绪不高所以我说，不要谢谢。他大约还没察觉到我语气不对所以把这个玩笑继续了下去，然后我就看见他发过来这样一条消息，“而且你头发也不够长。”　　我知道他在开玩笑可我就是控制不住自己生气，然后我回复他，我头发够不够长关你屁事啊。　　怎么看都知道这绝对算不上什么好话，而我说这句话的原因仅仅是因为对方开了个无伤大雅的玩笑。　　莫名其妙的烦躁，莫名其妙的生气，我甚至都没办法好好的跟家人讲几句话。　　但是每次发完脾气又总是很自我唾弃，怎么会有这么讨人厌的人？　　怎么会有这么讨人厌的人呢。
samples.translation: I always feel like I'm becoming a mean, nasty, and unpleasant person. A long time ago, I remember I was a patient and relatively gentle person. Some said I was stubborn, but no one ever said I had a bad temper. Even when I had conflicts with others, I was mild-mannered and hardly ever said anything harsh. But recently, specifically after returning home this time, I suddenly realized I've become mean, nasty, and irritable. I've even lost almost all the patience I used to have when playing with my younger sister. Every time I get angry, I keep wondering: Are they being too much, or am I overreacting? For example, the other day, a junior member in our department missed producing one episode of a program for some reason. Almost everyone else had little reaction, but I was genuinely furious inside and gave him an extremely unfriendly scolding. Actually, while chatting with him, I was trying very hard to suppress my temper—after all, behind a screen, I could maintain a gentler image. But he still quietly mentioned once, "Senior XX is so fierce." Maybe I'm much better when facing others, but the closer someone is to me, the less polite I become, somewhat like taking advantage of their affection. But it's the kind of taking advantage that's really unpleasant. A couple of days ago, I was chatting with a boy I'm very close to. He saw a photo on the school's confession wall and sent it to me, perhaps just joking, saying, "Do you want to try the hairstyle this girl mentioned?" Maybe because I was already in a low mood, I said, "No, thanks." He probably didn't notice my tone was off and continued the joke, and then I saw him send this message: "Besides, your hair isn't long enough." I knew he was joking, but I couldn't control my anger, so I replied, "Whether my hair is long enough is none of your damn business." Anyone can tell that's definitely not a nice thing to say, and I said it just because the other person made a harmless joke. I get inexplicably irritable and angry; I can't even have a proper conversation with my family. But every time I lose my temper, I always feel intense self-loathing: How can there be such an unpleasant person? How can there be such an unpleasant person?

samples.translation: My mom left enough food for a week and hurried back to China. Up until the last moment before leaving, she was stewing pork ribs, making minced meat noodles, soup, wrapping dumplings and wontons, baking my favorite pancakes, watering all the plants at home, and even prepared enough traditional Chinese medicine for two days. My mom is just that kind of person—always considerate of others and incredibly hardworking. I couldn't hold back and cried loudly at the airport; I didn't want to lose composure and worry my mom. Although I'll be returning to China in just over two months, goodbyes always feel so long, and even after going back, I'll have to return here again. Lately, I often recall childhood memories, remembering even the details, sometimes getting lost in them for a long time, and feeling particularly down when I snap out of it—wondering if this is a manifestation of my illness. Recently, I've had severe breast engorgement, and after crying several times since my mom left, it seems my milk supply has decreased... Little troublemaker, I hope you can be good this week and not torment me too much. Your grandma will be here next week, and then I can focus on taking medication and treating my illness. I want to go back to being my carefree self. I can't be a great mom, I just hope to be a happy one.

samples.original: 一个没有梦想的人，是一个不完整的人。让梦想成真，这是实现自身价值的重要途径之一。梦想是经不起犹豫的，在迟迟得不到实际行动的时候，梦想也就破碎了。没有实际行动，就算你有再美好的梦想，再完美的计划，都不过是个幻想。￼有了梦想，就应该为之努力，用实际行动去实现它。而不是坐等天上掉馅饼，等着梦想有朝一日，就自己实现了。在确定好目标以后，总会有那么一些的担忧，害怕过程太长，自己不能够坚持；害怕会失败；害怕太困难，自己不能够做好……正因为这种害怕的心理，在这世界上，能够真正实现自己的梦想的人少之又少。￼实现梦想首先就要“肯做”，然后在这个基础上“坚持做”。实现一个梦想，本来就不是一件容易的事情。没有谁是一步到位的，那些成功人士，在追求梦想的过程之中，总是表现出一种过人的毅力，在此期间，他们失败过很多次，可最终他们不还是成功了吗。著名演员史泰龙在高中的时候，就想要当一名演员。于是他去找那些导演和制片人，想要一个机会。可是整整三年，始终没有一个人看好他，没有人认为他是一个有表演天赋的人。在这三年之中，他从失败中总结了很多经验，终于一个拒绝了他20多次的导演给了他一个机会。正因为这个机会，他成了家喻户晓的明星了。￼你只闻到了他们的香水，却没有看到他们的汗水；你只看到他们光鲜亮丽的外表，却没看到他们遍体鳞伤的身体。梦想就是一场注定孤独的旅行，这路上少不了外界的嘲笑，和各种失败，但那又怎样，只要你脚踏实地的去做，才会离梦想越来越近。#正能量# 六盘水
samples.translation: A person without a dream is an incomplete person. Making dreams come true is one of the important ways to realize one's own value. Dreams cannot withstand hesitation; when they are not followed by actual action for too long, they shatter. Without actual action, no matter how beautiful your dream or how perfect your plan, it is merely a fantasy. Once you have a dream, you should strive for it and realize it through practical action, not sit waiting for a pie to fall from the sky, hoping the dream will fulfill itself one day. After setting a goal, there are always some worries: fear the process is too long and you cannot persevere; fear of failure; fear it is too difficult and you cannot do it well... It is precisely because of this fear that very few people in this world truly realize their dreams. To realize a dream, you must first be "willing to do," and then on that basis, "persist in doing." Realizing a dream is never easy. No one succeeds in one step. Those successful people always demonstrate extraordinary perseverance in the process of pursuing their dreams. During this time, they failed many times, but in the end, didn't they still succeed? The famous actor Sylvester Stallone wanted to become an actor in high school. So he went to directors and producers seeking an opportunity. But for three whole years, no one believed in him; no one thought he had acting talent. During those three years, he learned many lessons from failure, and finally a director who had rejected him over 20 times gave him a chance. Because of that opportunity, he became a household name star. You only smell their perfume, but do not see their sweat; you only see their glamorous appearance, but not their bruised and battered bodies. A dream is a journey destined to be lonely, inevitably accompanied by external ridicule and various failures along the way. But so what? Only by doing things down-to-earth will you get closer and closer to your dream. #PositiveEnergy# Liupanshui

samples.original: #泰国佛牌# 1、什么是一心三藏？空如来藏：就是我们无形无相的真心本来面目。不空如来藏：就是东南西北四维上下、过去现在未来，十方三世，上至诸佛菩萨，下至天人鬼畜，旁及山河大地、花草树木、风云雨雾，一切有形有相的万法。空不空如来藏：我们无形无相的真心本来面目，它本来具足一切万法，这就叫做空不空如来藏；一切有形有相的万法当下就是无形无相的真心本来面目所变现，这就叫做不空空如来藏，也就是空不空如来藏。三个如来藏，当下就是一个东西，也就是十法界的万法，当下就是一个人一个念之所变现，这就叫做一心三藏。2、用对照法观照一心三藏《妙法莲华经》的经题，就是以莲华命名，莲华也叫荷花，莲花之根也就是那个藕，藕切开之后，里面中间一个孔，周边还有八个孔。孔就表‘空如来藏’；藕肉就表‘不空如来藏’；在藕外面看到藕肉，看不到里面的孔，不管你看到看不到，他是不是都在啊，这就叫做空不空如来藏；整个的一只藕就是一心三藏，所以藕是特定表法的，是表我们的真心本来面目的。文殊菩萨在《楞严经》偈颂里讲“顶礼如来藏，无漏不思议”。‘如’就是‘空如来藏’，‘来’就是‘不空如来藏’。我们由性就能见相，所以“空如来藏”当下就是“空不空如来藏”。同样的道理，我们由相见到性，所以这个“不空如来藏”当下就是“不空空如来藏’，也就是“空不空如来藏”。当下就是三个“如来藏”即“一心三藏”。对照《佛说阿弥陀经》。在佛法里‘阿’就是表无相，比喻我们无形无相的真心本来面目，就叫做空如来藏。“弥陀”译成汉语叫“量”，是表无量无边、无穷无尽的万法，就叫做不空如来藏。阿弥陀就是空不空如来藏，所以一心三藏就是“阿弥陀佛”。《心经》里有句话叫“是诸法空相”。“空”表“空如来藏”，“相”表“不空如来藏”，“空相”就叫空不空如来藏。“是”表“空如来藏”，“诸法”表“不空如来藏”，“是诸法”就是“空不空如来藏”。在《法华经》中又提到“一实相印”，“实”表“空如来藏”“相”表“不空如来藏”，“实相”就是“空不空如来藏”。佛法里还讲“理”和“事”。“理”就是表我们"真心本体"，所以“理”表“空如来藏”，“事”表“不空如来藏”，“理事不二”，就是“空不空如来藏”。对照如是我闻，“如”表“空如来藏”，“是”表“不空如来藏”，“我”就表“空不空如来藏”，“闻”就是明白一心三藏。如果讲“一”和“多”，“一”就叫“空如来藏”，“多”就叫“不空如来藏”，“一多无碍”就是“空不空如来藏”。如果讲“权”和“实”，“实”就叫“空如来藏”，“权”就叫“不空如来藏”，“权实不二”就是“空不空如来藏”。“离一切相”就叫“空如来藏”，“即一切法”就叫“不空如来藏”，“离一切相，即一切法”就是“空不空如来藏”。“持无量义”就叫“空如来藏”，“总一切法”就叫“不空如来藏”，“总一切法，持无量义”就是“空不空如来藏”。“槃”就叫“空如来藏”，“涅”就叫“不空如来藏”，“涅槃”就是“空不空如来藏”。“真心”就叫“空如来藏”，“妄心”就叫“不空如来藏”，“妄心往生到真心即往生”就是“空不空如来藏”。3、用拿手好戏来观照一心三藏这个“拳头”表“空如来藏”，“手掌”表“不空如来藏”，“拳头”当下就是“手掌”，叫做“空不空如来藏”。“手掌”当下就是“拳头”，叫做“不空空如来藏”。这个手“拳掌不二”就是表一心三藏。4、用做梦来观照一心三藏这梦中有老爸老妈、同修同事，还有牛马猪羊，还有好人、坏人、强盗、土匪，还有香蕉苹果、桌子板凳、刮风下雨、牛屎狗粪，这一切梦境就叫『不空如来藏』。虽然梦境万千，正在一边打呼噜一边做梦的那个人他如如不动，这就是『空如来藏』。梦人当下就是梦境，这叫做『空不空如来藏』；梦境当下就是梦人，这叫做『不空空如来藏』。『不空空如来藏』就是『空不空如来藏』。『三个如来藏』当下就是『一个念』即一心三藏。我们每一个人都在做梦，每一个人都有那一个念，而且我们不能分开这是我的念，那是你的念，所以尽虚空遍法界、天人鬼畜就是一个念，在佛法里叫『阿赖耶识』,叫『第八识』。我们正在做梦的人那个念叫第七识，第七识是无量，第八识是一，『无量的第七识』就是『一个第八识』，『无量的万法』就是『一个念』，就是『一个阿赖耶识』。梦中的境界，从有情到无情都是这样。 瓦房店市正能量
samples.translation: #Thai Buddhist Amulets# 1. What is One Mind Three Treasuries? Empty Tathagata-garbha: This is our true, formless, and markless original face. Non-empty Tathagata-garbha: This refers to all phenomena with form and marks—the ten directions and three periods (past, present, future), the four cardinal and four intermediate directions, above and below, from Buddhas and Bodhisattvas above to heavenly beings, humans, ghosts, and animals below, as well as mountains, rivers, the earth, flowers, grass, trees, wind, clouds, rain, and mist. Empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha: Our true, formless, and markless original face inherently possesses all phenomena; this is called empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha. All phenomena with form and marks are, in the very moment, manifestations of the true, formless, and markless original face; this is called non-empty-empty Tathagata-garbha, which is also empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha. The three Tathagata-garbhas are, in the very moment, one thing. That is, all phenomena of the ten dharma realms are, in the very moment, manifestations of one mind, one thought. This is called One Mind Three Treasuries. 2. Using comparative methods to contemplate One Mind Three Treasuries The title of the "Lotus Sutra" is named after the lotus flower, also called the water lily. The root of the lotus, the lotus root, when cut open, has one hole in the center and eight holes around it. The holes represent 'Empty Tathagata-garbha'; the lotus root flesh represents 'Non-empty Tathagata-garbha'; seeing the lotus root flesh outside but not the holes inside—whether you see them or not, they are still there—this is called 'Empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha'. The entire lotus root is One Mind Three Treasuries, so the lotus root specifically symbolizes the dharma, representing our true original face. In the verse of the "Shurangama Sutra," Manjushri Bodhisattva said, "I bow to the Tathagata-garbha, the non-outflowing and inconceivable." 'Thus' (如) is 'Empty Tathagata-garbha', 'Come

samples.translation: #Choi Seung-ri Suffers from Severe Depression# Every time I see or hear news about depression, I truly feel sad and scared. A young girl in the prime of her life was killed bit by bit. Yes, perhaps for her it was a happy thing, but for those who liked and loved her, it is another kind of pain. I can truly understand the despair she once experienced—completely misunderstood and misinterpreted by those who didn’t understand. She hoped to be understood, but the world only seeks momentary gratification. Everyone thinks depression is scary, but I believe what’s truly terrifying are those words that push depression patients step by step toward death—irresponsible, offhand remarks that may not be outright malicious. When you cannot control the other self within your body driving you toward death, the pain is unbearable. When you can only bring sadness to those around you, you feel so guilty, thinking you should die, that you shouldn’t exist in this world. Your disappearance might be a case of “short pain rather than long pain” for everyone. Everyone panics because of depression, but no one ever considers that the disease itself isn’t scary—what’s scary is the uncontrollable human heart. Ma’anshan · Anhui University of Technology East Campus

samples.translation: For the past six years, I often dream of a deceased person, though we haven't seen each other for over a decade. Every so often during these six years, I dream of him. The dreams vary, but I frequently dream of him, almost always with the same feelings: hazy, entangled, longing, yearning. In the dreams, I really want to tell him something, but he always doesn't recognize me, or we miss each other, which always makes me very sad. He was a teacher from my elementary school. I started dreaming of him at some point during fifth or sixth grade, but in reality, I don't think of him at all, and we have no connection—truly like strangers, as we haven't met for over ten years. But now I've been dreaming of him for many years, and I still don't understand why I keep dreaming of him. After each dream, I have to think about whether it was real or a dream, but after a few days, I forget—forget him, forget the dream. Yet, the next time I dream of him, it feels like he's back in my heart. I don't know why this happens, and I don't want to dream of him anymore! It's not that I deliberately seek answers; it's been almost six years of dreaming of him. Xi'an, Gaoling County.

samples.original: 微信朋友圈已很久没有更新了，没有关注我的人，也没有想让看的某人。我在想，三十多岁的我，把日子过得稀碎，很挫败。有时候会埋怨父母一直以来的的批评教育，把我养育的足够自卑，一直认为自己不配得不配爱，说什么做什么都是错的。这是原生家庭带给我的根深蒂固的影响。第一段婚姻像一滩死水，没有生活默契，没有未来期望。图物质？各花各的，产检，生娃，养娃都是自己掏钱。图感情？吵架离家出走，从来不担心不紧张不联系。图脾气好？确实，三脚踹不出一个屁，能把人活活憋死。就这样彼此耗了7年，留给我一套房子一个娃娃。从此甚少联系。第二段婚姻像过山车，原本幸福的生活，未来的憧憬，瞬间崩塌。嫖娼，跟前任纠缠，网赌，打麻将，怀孕一次家暴，往死里朝头部和肚子挥拳头，坐月子一次家暴。说出来可笑，住着我的房子，花着我的钱，辱骂殴打我和大儿子，我还百般迁就讨好他，我可能是脑子有病吧。最后一次家暴，我让他滚出了我的家。传说中二婚，留给我70万的负债一个娃娃。于是，我终于作死成功，把自己作成了负债70万，无业，肥胖，抑郁，带俩娃的单亲老妈子。怪谁？不怪任何人，都怪自己，没有自信没有眼光没有底线没有本事，好吃懒做坐享其成。活该这个结果。为自己的选择负责。我不会做祥林嫂，以后也不会再提原生家庭，更不会再提两次失败的婚姻，此生不会再碰爱情和婚姻。当下，承担责任，抚养好两个孩子，调整自己的心态和生活，努力工作赚钱，踏踏实实的过好自己的日子。
samples.translation: My WeChat Moments haven't been updated for a long time. There's no one paying attention to me, nor anyone specific I want to see it. I'm thinking, in my thirties, I've made a complete mess of my life, and it's very defeating. Sometimes I resent my parents' constant criticism in raising me, which made me sufficiently insecure, always believing I'm undeserving and unworthy of love, feeling that everything I say or do is wrong. This is the deep-rooted influence my family of origin has had on me. My first marriage was like stagnant water—no默契 in life, no expectations for the future. For material gain? We spent our own money separately; prenatal checkups, childbirth, and raising the child were all paid for by myself. For感情? When we argued and I left home, there was never any worry, concern, or contact. For a good temper? True, you couldn't get a word out of him with three kicks; it was enough to suffocate you. We dragged on like this for seven years, leaving me with a house and a child. Since then, we've had little contact. My second marriage was like a roller coaster; what was originally a happy life and future dreams collapsed instantly. Prostitution, entanglement with an ex, online gambling, mahjong, domestic violence once while pregnant—fists aimed at my head and stomach trying to kill me, and domestic violence again during postpartum confinement. It's laughable to say—living in my house, spending my money, verbally abusing and beating me and my eldest son, and yet I still tried in every way to please him. I must have something wrong with my brain. The last time he was violent, I kicked him out of my home. As the saying goes about second marriages, it left me with 700,000 in debt and a child. So, I finally succeeded in ruining myself, turning into a single mother with 700,000 in debt, unemployed, obese, depressed, and raising two kids. Who's to blame? No one but myself—no confidence, no discernment, no底线, no ability, lazy and wanting to enjoy without effort. I deserve this outcome. I take responsibility for my choices. I won't be like Xianglin's Wife; I won't mention my family of origin again in the future, nor will I bring up my two failed marriages. I will never touch love or marriage again in this lifetime. For now

samples.original: 躁郁症有很多时候会想，或许有什么法子是可以解决这些看起来并不严重实际却很要命的问题的，只是还没寻到而已。生活在这个世界上，除非成功了，否则说什么都是个笑话。老人们用一辈子所经历的人生波折来劝慰年轻人：不要太猖狂。但总没人愿意听。过山车并不是最好的比喻，因为从过山车上下来，还能回到原本的生活里，但这些波折，没有回头路。“一点制服不了的小情绪算什么？你只是还没遇到人生的大起大落大灾大难罢了。” 落进这样的圈里，困住的只有自己而已。道理都懂的，就像吃药身体也会免疫一样，排解的法子也会一个又一个失灵。以前爱喝酒，抽烟，爱看些血淋淋的片子，用一切不美好的事情来麻痹自己，这个人间还值得。每回一次重庆，就会证明一次，来来往往，除了看客在看笑话，没有值得。还小的时候，不太懂为什么生活如此艰难，还要不辞辛苦地活着，以为长大了会懂。其实长大了也不会懂，不是问题不在了，而是放弃了。才知道，原来吃糖也还是会苦。
samples.translation: With bipolar disorder, there are many times when I think maybe there is some way to solve these problems that don't seem serious but are actually deadly, it just hasn't been found yet. Living in this world, unless you succeed, anything you say is a joke. Old people use a lifetime of life's ups and downs to comfort the young: don't be too arrogant. But no one is ever willing to listen. A roller coaster isn't the best metaphor, because you can get off a roller coaster and return to your original life, but with these ups and downs, there's no turning back. "What's a little uncontrollable emotion? You just haven't encountered life's major rises and falls, disasters and calamities yet." Falling into such a trap, the only one trapped is yourself. I understand the reasoning, just like the body can become immune to medicine, the methods of release also fail one after another. I used to love drinking, smoking, watching bloody movies, using all kinds of unpleasant things to numb myself, thinking this world is still worth it. Every time I return to Chongqing, it proves once again, coming and going, except for onlookers watching the joke, nothing is worth it. When I was young, I didn't quite understand why life is so hard and we still labor tirelessly to live, thinking I'd understand when I grew up. Actually, you don't understand when you grow up either; it's not that the problems are gone, but that you've given up. Only then do I realize that even eating sugar can still be bitter.

Let me tell you, this mobile app is "Zhong Xiang Tuan" "Zhong Xiang Tuan" "Zhong Xiang Tuan" (important things said three times). "Zhong Xiang Tuan" is a mobile app that brings a new way of consumption, where users can earn secondary network sharing rewards by sharing merchants or discounts with friends. For example: User (A) invites friend (B) to become a Zhong Xiang Tuan user. After friend (B) downloads it and uses Zhong Xiang Tuan for rebates, inviter (A) can receive a reward; when friend (B) invites friend (C) to spend, user (A) and user (B), as sharers, can still receive rewards; when friend (C) invites friend (D) to spend, user (A) exits the profit-sharing, while user (B) and user (C) can receive rewards. No additional spending is needed to get profit cashback. Still not clear? Let me put it more directly. Come on, let me give you an example: If someone shares with 100 friends, and each friend recommends and shares with 20 friends, the total is 2,100 people; if each person spends 1,000 yuan annually through the platform, then the sharing user's annual income is 2,100 * 1,000 = 2,100,000 yuan, the platform's income is 2,100,000 * 10% = 210,000 yuan, and this person's income is: 210,000 * 15% = 31,500 yuan. samples.translation: Suddenly remembered a cute thing from high school. There was a boy I really liked. One day he changed his hairstyle, and when I texted him, he even sent a preview photo. On the day school started, I was wondering when I'd see him. Then, while queuing in the cafeteria at noon, I turned around and he was right behind me. That boy was already good-looking, and with his new curly hair, he looked especially adorable. I just kept staring at him, completely forgetting I was in the lunch line. Maybe he felt a bit awkward, so he asked me, "Does it look good?" (Honestly, when I saw him, I was completely stunned—how could he be so handsome? I really wanted to reach out and ruffle his hair, cup his face in my hands and squeeze it, then shout, "You're just too cute!") But since I was in the secret crush phase, I could only pretend to be slightly surprised and say, "It's pretty good." (Yet I had a lewd smile on my face, my cheeks were aching...) A few days later, I noticed he had changed his hair back. I don't remember if I asked him why he changed it again; I just figured it was his preference and didn't want to pry. Sometimes I blame my memory for remembering everything, and when I look back, it's always more bitter than sweet—just licking sugar off broken glass.

samples.original: 已是凌晨4点，身边的你已经睡去，而我确没有睡意，我们今天聊了很多，聊到你的以前，你上大学的时候，是怎么的开心，怎么无忧无虑，怎么的想尽所有办法吃到自己想吃的，从你的大学男友，聊到你现在的那个他，我傻傻的回应着，不想打断你，即使心里听了不会很舒服，但是毕竟都是过去，像这种话题，你不说给我听，也没有第二个会知道了吧，我喜欢做你的聆听者，喜欢你讲你每段故事，可能我没有你那么好的口才，谁让大哥我没有文化。其实我心里也有很多话想对你说，但是不知道是不是我敏感了，我觉得你没有从前那样有耐心，今天我们聊着聊着，也许你是不经意的说出你对我的看法，你说你对我恨铁不成钢，是啊，其实我们也许根本就不是一个层次的人，只是命运让我们相逢，相知，相遇，相爱，而且，还要爱而不得。
samples.translation: It's already 4 a.m., you beside me have fallen asleep, but I have no drowsiness. We talked a lot today, about your past, how happy and carefree you were in college, how you tried every way to eat what you wanted, from your college boyfriend to your current him. I responded foolishly, not wanting to interrupt you, even though hearing it didn't feel comfortable inside, but after all, it's all in the past. Topics like these, if you don't tell me, probably no one else would know. I like being your listener, I like hearing each of your stories. Maybe I don't have your eloquence, but who says this big brother isn't cultured. Actually, I have a lot I want to say to you too, but I don't know if I'm being oversensitive—I feel you're not as patient as before. Today, as we talked, maybe you unintentionally shared your thoughts about me, saying you're frustrated with my lack of progress. Yeah, maybe we're just not on the same level, only fate brought us together, to know each other, meet, and love, and yet, to love without being able to have.

samples.original: 睡着，突然想起那天早上从考场出来给爸爸打电话，接通后电话那头他妹妹在哭，说我爸在邛崃，听到这里以为爸爸有重伤去医院了，然后立刻她就说在火葬场，接着就是无数指责我的话，我没有听清楚…谁也不知道那些天我是怎么过的，不能去别人家串门，心里是巨大的痛苦和折磨，熬了几个通宵睡不着，堂姐有空就过来陪我说说话……我多希望妈妈在身边，亲人在身边，可是没有人出现在面前来帮助我，或者陪着我，好多无助，找不到任何人讲，无数次地期盼亲爱的兄弟姐妹谁能来看望我。爸爸，您在天有灵吗，看到你的家人是怎么对我吗？我明知道他们是因为爸爸有一点遗产来诘难我，也忍不住会把他的去世跟自己联系在一起。多么苦啊，谁知道。我一遍又一遍地问自己，究竟做错了什么，大家都要这样对我？难道是因为我天真，听话，去爱害我的人？我不想去承受这些，不想去管那些利益纠纷，奶奶那套房子是爸爸出钱的，但我也不想去争了，只求上天放过我，不要让我再和他们有任何交集，不要让我再遇到姓陈姓潘那样的人。我真的很穷，可是我不愿意再因为利益和他们争。
samples.translation: Asleep, I suddenly remembered that morning when I came out of the exam hall and called my dad. When the call connected, his sister was crying on the other end, saying my dad was in Qionglai. Hearing this, I thought he was seriously injured and at the hospital, but then she immediately said he was at the crematorium, followed by countless accusations against me that I couldn't make out clearly... No one knows how I got through those days. I couldn't visit others' homes, my heart filled with immense pain and torment. I stayed up for several sleepless nights. My cousin came to keep me company and talk whenever she had time... How I wished my mom were by my side, my family were by my side, but no one appeared before me to help or accompany me. So much helplessness, with no one to talk to. Countless times, I hoped my dear siblings would come visit me. Dad, are you watching from above? Do you see how your family treats me? I know full well they're harassing me over Dad's small inheritance, yet I can't help but link his death to myself. So bitter, who knows? I ask myself over and over, what did I do wrong for everyone to treat me this way? Is it because I'm naive, obedient, and loving toward those who harm me? I don't want to bear this, I don't want to deal with these disputes over interests. Grandma's house was paid for by Dad, but I don't want to fight for it anymore. I just beg heaven to spare me, to not let me have any further dealings with them, to not let me encounter people with surnames like Chen or Pan again. I'm truly poor, but I'm unwilling to fight with them over money anymore.

samples.original: 销我亿劫颠倒想  不历僧祇获法身         这就是讲「华开莲现，即悟即证」！其它方便法中，藏教修无量劫不能明心见性，修通教别教恒河沙数的人难有一个人成就，无量百千万亿劫也难得成就。唯有《法华经》《楞严经》之「一心三藏」，来一个成就一个，来两个成就一双，百分之百，千分之千，万分之万！而且成就高，下可保底不落六道轮回，上不封顶直到十地等觉，乃至像龙女那样成为究竟圆满之佛！就是成就率百分之百，成就的品位高！成就的时间呢，你可以一生成就，也可以一个月成就，也可以一天成就，也可以一时一念成就！所以观照这段经文，就销除我无量劫以来的颠倒妄想啊！有哪些颠倒妄想呢？时间上颠倒：时间上有过去、现在、未来。空间上有颠倒：东南西北上下十方（其实都是一念）。佛法上、世间法上有颠倒：认为什么法门都能成佛。种种的相貌上颠倒：有你、我、他。所以这个「颠倒」呢，我们从时间、空间、佛法、万法之相这四个角度来观照。   这么多颠倒啊，「不历僧祇获法身」呐！不需要经过无量百千万亿年而「获法身」，也就是说我当下就已经见到了法身，获得了法身。圆顿大法这个「获」视同于「证」。圆顿大法只愁悟，不愁证！在见道位所见到的真如与在证道位所证到的真如无二无别，你明心见性的当下就是如如佛。这是讲《楞严经》它的妙用不可思议！过去执着在时间是过去、现在、未来，是不是？那现在明白就是当下一念；过去执着十方虚空无穷大，现在知道都是当下自己一念心；过去认为太阳、月亮、山河大地、树木华草是无情；过去认为牛马猪羊、张三李四都是他，现在知道都是自己一个念，没有哪一法不是哪一法；过去认物为己，认己为物；现在来讲，己也是物，物也是己。大光明中谁非谁？这些颠倒想一颠就颠过来，无始以来的颠倒想当下一念就明白。这叫「一灯能除千年暗，一智能灭万年愚」！        下面的「不历僧祇获法身」是重复解释上面一句话，一念明白过来了，销去颠倒想了，叫「知妄即真，华开莲现，当下成佛」！所以别教菩萨从空出有，在通教禅宗的基础上从空出有，还要修三大阿僧祇劫！三大阿僧祇劫只能证到二行位的菩萨，也叫佛。比圆教佛还要低三十个等级，更何况别教以下，通教、藏教、小乘法更不用谈。可是到了圆教，成分真即佛，乃至到地上菩萨、十地菩萨、等觉菩萨都可以一生成就——一生就是我们这个人一生短短几十年，几十年就能成就，也可以一个月成就，可以一个时辰成就，甚至可以一念就成就，这叫「不历僧祇获法身」。「僧祇」，，是从别教往前讲，就不知道哪个猴年马月才能成就。圆顿大法是无量无量劫的功德，成就于一生一时一念当下，这是不可思议的大法呀！这里的「获」就是「悟」，就是证得。所以有些受方便法影响的人，把这个「获」看成是见道，他把见道和证道分开。对于方便法而言，见道以后要修要证，因为他那种见道还有漏，没有见全，见的是有或者见的是空，或者见的是亦有亦空，都不圆满。那种见道，那种所谓的悟解，必须要解行并重。所以他那种说法把「获」说成见道、悟解，并且还要修、还要证并没有错，因为他见得不圆满。对于圆顿大法，见道即是修道、即是证道。所以圆顿大法「不历修证、不历次第，无修无证，即见即修即证」。       佛在《法华经》《楞严经》就是这么讲啊！摩登伽女是个下九流的坏女人，听佛讲几句话当下证三果罗汉，再听文殊菩萨讲了几句偈颂，当下证四果罗汉；舍利弗和憍陈那听佛讲了一遍苦集灭道，当下证四果罗汉。这还是讲小乘法呀！讲大乘法，八岁的龙女听文殊菩萨讲了《法华经》，当下成为妙觉位的佛—圆满之佛！《法华经》《楞严经》里这样的例子很多啊！无量百千万亿的众生听佛讲一段经、一品经乃至半个小时的开示，当下无量的人成为阿罗汉、辟支佛、住位菩萨、行位菩萨、回向位菩萨、地上菩萨、直至十地、等觉位。印光大师是近代高僧，印光大师一世的精华就是四句话：「法华奥典，妙冠群经，闻即往生，位齐等觉」!《楞严经》从头到尾几乎都是在讲，成佛就是当下的事！当下！
samples.translation: It dispels my countless kalpas of inverted thoughts, without traversing asamkhyeyas one attains the Dharmakaya. This explains "the flower blooms and the lotus appears, awakening is immediate realization"! In other expedient teachings, the Tripitaka teachings practice for immeasurable kalpas yet cannot illuminate the mind and see one's nature; among those practicing the Prajna teachings or the Distinct teachings, as numerous as the sands of the Ganges, it is difficult for even one to achieve attainment; even over countless hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas, achievement is exceedingly rare. Only the "One Mind, Threefold Truth" of the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra ensures that whoever comes achieves attainment—one comes, one achieves; two come, a pair achieves—one hundred percent, one thousand per thousand, ten thousand per ten thousand! Moreover, the attainment is of high grade: at minimum, it guarantees not falling into the six realms of rebirth, and at maximum, it is unbounded, reaching even the ten grounds and equal enlightenment, or like the Dragon Girl, becoming a completely perfect Buddha! That is an achievement rate of one hundred percent and a high grade of attainment! As for the time of achievement, you can achieve in one lifetime, or in one month, or in one day, or even in an instant, in a single thought! Therefore, contemplating this passage of scripture dispels the inverted delusions I have harbored over immeasurable kalpas! What inverted delusions are there? Inversion regarding time: time is seen as past, present, and future. Inversion regarding space: east, west, south, north, up, down, the ten directions (all are actually a single thought). Inversion regarding Dharma and worldly phenomena: believing any method can lead to Buddhahood. Inversion regarding various appearances: existence of you, me, and him. So, we contemplate this "inversion" from these four perspectives: time, space, Dharma, and the characteristics of all phenomena. So many inversions are dispelled, and "without traversing asamkhyeyas one attains the Dharmakaya"! Without needing to pass through countless hundreds of thousands of millions of years, one "attains the Dharmakaya," meaning I have already seen the Dharmakaya in the present moment, attained the Dharmakaya. samples.translation: I really didn't expect this dream to suffocate me awake. Yesterday, I saw on a friend's social media that her beloved ex got married. I thought about it and still felt I should tell her, but before I could say anything, she asked about it herself. Her reaction was terrifyingly calm. I said, "Oh my god, I feel awful just looking at it, I really can't imagine if something like that happened to me, whether I could handle it." She said it's okay, when it really happens, it's actually not that painful. Maybe what you think about before sleeping is what you dream about. I dreamed that my ex sent me some weird messages for several days in a row. I was quite happy at the time, and then suddenly one day, a video popped up. What was in the video? It seemed he went to find a girl he liked—not the kind he was with—and livestreamed the whole confession for me to see. Honestly, they were very sweet, but to me, it seemed somewhat too cruel. In the dream, he didn't say much. I said, "That's great, you should go for it." He seemed to want to say something, but before I could hear it, I woke up. The dream felt so real that when I woke up, I couldn't immediately tell it was a dream. It's been over ten minutes since I woke up. I went and told Liu Sang about this. Liu Sang said I'm probably just overthinking things because of my period. Up until now, I just feel so stifled, really suffocated, almost choking. I don't know how to face it if what happened to my friend happens to me. But thinking about it later, it makes sense; my ex is a few years older than me, so it would be normal if he got married. I just hope that if that day really comes, I can be a bit calmer.

samples.translation: People who aren't good at swallowing pills really have it rough with lithium carbonate. Accidentally letting a bit dissolve in my mouth made me vomit all day, to the point my eyes were bloodshot, yet I still felt unbearably nauseous. But the drug's effect is so intense; my whole being feels tightly suppressed like an empty shell, incapable of acting on suicidal thoughts, with no sense of self-awareness. The only proof of being alive is crying, perpetually physiological crying. samples.translation: I think the coolest thing I've done recently was my solo trip to Chengdu over a week ago. Stepping onto Chengdu's soil after getting off the plane, I felt a lightness from inside out. I love the simple and warm-hearted Sichuan people who call you "little sister, come eat!" and tease you in Sichuan-accented Mandarin with phrases like "what the heck are you laughing at." I love the spicy, fragrant kick of Sichuan hotpot and have come to accept the oil dipping sauce. I love Chengdu's bustling street life. I love the streets lined with ginkgo trees. Only after experiencing it did I truly understand the joy of solo travel—freedom, ease, real stress relief. I finally grasped the meaning of the saying "the young shouldn't enter Sichuan, the old shouldn't leave it." Chengdu's comfort is truly perfect for living, with endlessly delightful food and stunningly good-looking locals. It's just so damn comfortable.

samples.original: #上海美食##上海魔都探店#店铺：陵水酒家地址：荣华东道119弄2号巴黎花园B楼107号(近水城南路)藏在居民楼里的“韩式料理”，人均100➕ 味道很正宗哦❤️1⃣️炒年糕：KK奔着它去的，端上桌一大盘，足够3-4人吃了！年糕糯糯的，一抿即碎，也不粘牙；鱼饼入味软烂，有种韩国街头的味道。2⃣️泡菜拉面火锅：红彤彤的一大锅，里面有豆腐、泡菜、年糕、蔬菜；拉面是农心的，要自己加！热乎乎的吃上一锅，还是很爽的！味道有点偏酸，可能是泡菜的缘故，不过可以接受！3⃣️蔬菜炒牛肉：朋友点的，味道出奇的好吃！炒过的蔬菜，4-5种，水灵灵的，鲜香可口！4⃣️烤牛肋条：是店里帮你烤好剪好的。牛肉厚实大块，一咬还有汁水！外酥里嫩，包上蔬菜吃，层次爆棚！💥5⃣️土豆饼：应该是自家做的，上面还镶了一根菜叶！粘粘糯糯，没什么味道，要蘸上配的酱汁，才嗲！其实还有石锅拌饭、炒八爪鱼🐙，太饿了忘记拍照了，味道绝对不踩雷！五个人吃到扶墙走，才花了500➕，价格很实惠！期待下次的2⃣️刷！#网红美食##韩国料理# 上海·陵水酒家
samples.translation: #ShanghaiFood##ShanghaiExploration# Shop: Lingshui Restaurant Address: Room 107, Building B, Paris Garden, No. 2, Lane 119, Ronghua East Road (near Shuicheng South Road) "Korean cuisine" hidden in a residential building, about 100+ per person, very authentic taste ❤️ 1) Stir-fried rice cakes: KK went specifically for this. A large plate served, enough for 3-4 people! The rice cakes are soft and glutinous, melting in the mouth and not sticky; the fish cakes are flavorful and tender, giving a taste of Korean streets. 2) Kimchi ramen hot pot: A big red pot containing tofu, kimchi, rice cakes, vegetables; the ramen is Nongshim brand, you add it yourself! Eating a hot pot is still very satisfying! The taste is a bit sour, maybe because of the kimchi, but acceptable! 3) Stir-fried beef with vegetables: Ordered by a friend, surprisingly delicious! Stir-fried vegetables, 4-5 types, fresh and juicy, savory and tasty! 4) Grilled beef ribs: The shop grills and cuts them for you. The beef is thick and large, juicy when bitten! Crispy outside and tender inside, wrapped in vegetables, the layers explode! 💥 5) Potato pancake: Probably homemade, with a vegetable leaf embedded on top! Sticky and glutinous, not very flavorful, needs to be dipped in the provided sauce to be great! Actually, there were also stone pot bibimbap, stir-fried octopus 🐙, too hungry forgot to take photos, the taste is definitely not disappointing! Five people ate until stuffed, only spent 500+, very affordable price! Looking forward to the next visit! #TrendyFood##KoreanCuisine# Shanghai · Lingshui Restaurant

samples.original: 能够受持《法华经》的人，已在十万亿佛法中积累了道行。根据自己能不能受持《法华经》的法理法义，你可以检验自己的境界。最关键、最要命的问题是，《法华经》《楞严经》处处讲听经闻法，当下了生死成佛。最要害的问题往往最明显，连解释都不要解释，你一看就懂。可是往往许多人他一看不懂，十看不懂，怎么看都不懂，怎么劝他都不信。这种人就是过去世中他没有种下善根。佛在《法华经》《楞严经》这经王所讲之法你都不相信，你白修了。但有些人一听就能信解。
samples.translation: Those who can uphold the Lotus Sutra have already accumulated spiritual practice across trillions of Buddha-dharmas. Based on whether one can uphold the principles and meanings of the Lotus Sutra, you can examine your own spiritual level. The most crucial, vital issue is that the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra everywhere speak of listening to sutras and hearing the Dharma, thereby ending birth and death and attaining Buddhahood in the present moment. The most critical issues are often the most obvious, needing no explanation—you understand at a glance. Yet many people fail to understand at first glance, fail after ten glances, cannot comprehend no matter how they look, and refuse to believe no matter how they are persuaded. Such individuals simply did not plant virtuous roots in past lives.
